answer: We define a cryptoeconomic mechanism where each validator must deposit a staking collateral C verified via falcon signatures, binding their identities to a multi-round validation voyage. To prevent Sybil multiplication within the distributed state nebula, we introduce a subgame-perfect slashing penalty S governed by zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions.
